data.exact_reserve_text: The tables below show the Syndicate's cumulative incurred claims development, including both claims notified and IBNR for each underwriting year, together with the cumulative payments to date on a gross and net of reinsurance basis at the balance sheet date.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross prior-year reserve strengthening of approximately GBP 2.343m driven by adverse development on the 2020 underwriting year as shown in the gross claims development table. The strengthening represents about a 41% increase relative to the opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022. The report attributes development to actuarial re-estimation of IBNR and typical reserving uncertainty/large loss development rather than to a single named catastrophe.
raw_causal_phrases: The provision for claims outstanding comprises the estimated cost of settling all claims incurred but unpaid at the balance sheet date, whether reported or not.
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
reserve adequacy is monitored through quarterly review

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line was present. Prior-year development was computed from the gross claims development table (triangle) - only the 2020 underwriting year provided comparable diagonals, producing a gross strengthening of GBP 2.343m. No explicit narrative sentence quantified gross PYD; a net PYD figure was not separately stated. LOB-level prior-year movements are not quantified in the report.
